name: req-tpm
description: Requirement management where the requester and their agent act as the requirement's TPM: intake with a measurable expected outcome, priority recommendation for the owner, design decision record, cadence tracking that flags stale items, ship readiness, and evidence-based outcome review. Body in a Feishu doc, status in Meegle.
author: MiniMax Code team
